description: The Makita 4-1/2" SJS™II High Performance Angle Grinder with Brake (GA4591) features a powerful 15 Amp motor that delivers more power and features a variable speed controller that allows the user to adjust the speed from 2,800 - 11,500 to adjust speed to the application.The high performance angle grinder features SJS™II, which uses a leaf spring and cam gear drive mechanism designed to reduce vibration and provide increased operating comfort during prolonged use. Vibration is further reduced by the vibration-dampening side handle, which provides increased comfort at work.The GA4591 features electronic control that provides a soft start that suppresses the start response and is designed to ensure smooth starts and a longer transmission life. The high performance sander features labyrinth construction gaskets and protects the engine and bearing from dust and debris for a longer tool life. The motor fan is designed with enlarged fins for increased airflow and a cooler running motor.The GA4591 features spiral bevel gears for smooth turns and more efficient energy transfer. It features an all-aluminum gear housing that provides excellent gear alignment and smooth transmission for increased durability and comfort. An electronic controller provides an electronic current limit that helps protect the motor from overloading in high torque applications.Comfort features include a "tool-less" wheel guard for easy adjustment and a slide switch with lock-on for continuous use.
